title: American based star, Casey808 does not disappoint in the release of his latest track “For Her”
htmlContent:
Hailing from Hilo, Hawai, Casey808 is a name worth mentioning in the music industry. Casey808 is a talented singer and songwriter who received the guidance and knowledge necessary to develop and perfect his craft. The lyrical genius has again proven himself by releasing his recent track "For Her."

Casey808's "For Her" is a brilliantly written Hip Hop love/emo piece of work, with the production being the perfect score for this tale that makes this song shine to the fullest. The talented star honed his musical abilities by working with many accomplished artists and producers. These include; Brian Kennedy (Producer for Brandy, Rihanna, and Jesse McCartney), Baby Bash, Scoop Deville, Bun B, and many more.
